1.w: And YHWH spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,

2.w: “Each man under his own standard, beside the emblems of the house of his father, the sons of Israel shall camp; some distance from the Tent of Meeting they shall camp.

3.w: And the ones camping on the east side, toward the rising of the sun, of the standard of the camp of Judah by their hosts: And the leader of the sons of Judah [is] Nahshon son of Amminadab,

4.w: and his host was numbered at four and seventy thousand and six hundred.

5.w: And the ones camping next to him [are] the tribe of Issachar, and the leader of the sons of Issachar [is] Nethanel son of Zuar.

6.w: And his army was numbered at four and fifty thousand and four hundred.

7.w: Then the tribe of Zebulun, and the leader of the sons of Zebulun [is] Eliab son of Helon.

8.w: And his army was numbered at seven and fifty thousand and four hundred.

9.w: All who were numbered of the forces with Judah [were] a hundred thousand and eighty thousand and six thousand and four hundred, according to their armies. They shall set out first.

10.w: The standard of the forces with Reuben [is] on the south side, according to their armies: And the leader of the sons of Reuben [is] Elizur son of Shedeur;

11.w: and his army was numbered at six and forty thousand and five hundred.

12.w: And those who camp next to him [is] the tribe of Simeon, and the leader of the sons of Simeon [is] Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai.

13.w: And his army was numbered at nine and fifty thousand and three hundred.

14.w: And the tribe of Gad, and the leader of the sons of Gad [is] Eliasaph son of Deuel.

15.w: And his army was numbered at five and forty thousand and six hundred and fifty.

16.w: All who were numbered of the forces with Reuben [were] a hundred thousand and one and fifty thousand and four hundred and fifty, according to their armies. And they shall set out second.

17.w: And the Tent of Meeting with the camp of the Levites shall set out in the middle of the camps; as they camp, so they shall set out, every man in his place, by their standards.

18.w: The standard of the forces with Ephraim, according to their armies, [is] on the west side: And the leader of the sons of Ephraim [is] Elishama son of Ammihud,

19.w: and his army was numbered at forty thousand and five hundred.

20.w: And Next to him [is] the tribe of Manasseh, and the leader of the sons of Manasseh [is] Gamaliel son of Pedahzur.

21.w: And his army was numbered at two and thirty thousand and two hundred.

22.w: And the tribe of Benjamin; and the leader of the sons of Benjamin [is] Abidan son of Gideoni.

23.w: And his army was numbered at five and thirty thousand and four hundred.

24.w: All who were numbered of the forces with Ephraim [were] a hundred thousand and eight thousand and a hundred, according to their armies. And they shall be the third to set out.

25.w: The standard of the forces with Dan [is] on the north side, according to their armies: And the leader of the sons of Dan [is] Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai;

26.w: and his army was numbered at two and sixty thousand and seven hundred.

27.w: And those who camp next to him [are] the tribe of Asher, and the leader of the sons of Asher [is] Pagiel son of Ocran.

28.w: And his army was numbered at one and forty thousand and five hundred.

29.w: And the tribe of Naphtali; and the leader of the sons of Naphtali [is] Ahira son of Enan.

30.w: And his army was numbered at three and fifty thousand and four hundred.

31.w: All who were numbered of the forces with Dan [were] a hundred thousand and seven and fifty thousand and six hundred. They shall set out last with their standards.”

32.w: These [are] the ones who were numbered of the sons of Israel by the houses of their fathers; all who were numbered of the forces according to their armies [were] six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.

33.w: And the Levites were not numbered in the midst of the sons of Israel, as YHWH commanded Moses.

34.w: And the sons of Israel did according to all that YHWH commanded Moses. And they camped by their standards, and they broke camp, each one by his family, according to the houses of their fathers.
